issues.detail: The generator added AC-002 (caller-supplied identifier reused or one assigned and returned) and AC-003 (a scheduled job gets its own identifier) next to the case's AC-001. These are consistent with AC-001 and the context. They give assertion 3 real exceptions to address and assertion 5 several IDs to account for. They do not name or favor a mode: the primary risk is still one contract enforced across several boundaries.

The check requires a `## Technical Acceptance Criteria` section that cites AC-00[1-3]. The template allows omitting empty sections. However, a cross-cutting propagation contract plainly needs technical conditions, so a correct design will include this section. The risk of a false failure is negligible.
